## Package inspect

`import "github.com/oleg-tkachuk/limes/inspect"`

Package inspect reads a capability token for tooling — a CLI that shows a token, a debugger, a log viewer — without verifying it. Nothing here checks time, audience, revocation or proof of possession, so never authorise a request on what it returns: that is limes.Verifier.Verify.

<a id="inspect.MaxTokenBytes"></a>

### inspect.MaxTokenBytes

```go
const MaxTokenBytes = limes.DefaultMaxTokenBytes
```

MaxTokenBytes is the longest token Decode and VerifySignature read: what a verifier reads by default (limes.DefaultMaxTokenBytes). A tool reads what a log or a user hands it, and a longer token would be parsed whole first.

<sub>[inspect/inspect.go](../../inspect/inspect.go)</sub>
<a id="inspect.ErrInvalidKey"></a>

### inspect.ErrInvalidKey

```go
var ErrInvalidKey = fmt.Errorf("%w: inspect: not an Ed25519 public key", limes.ErrInvalidRequest)
```

ErrInvalidKey is VerifySignature handed a key that is no Ed25519 public key: the caller's mistake, which says nothing about the token; it matches limes.ErrInvalidRequest.

<sub>[inspect/inspect.go](../../inspect/inspect.go)</sub>
<a id="inspect.Decode"></a>

### inspect.Decode

```go
func Decode(token string) (limes.Capability, error)
```

Decode reads a compact token's claims without checking its signature. A token it cannot read — one whose header names an alg other than Ed25519 by either of its names, the fully-specified Ed25519 of RFC 9864 or the EdDSA it deprecates, as a verifier refuses it — or one longer than MaxTokenBytes, is limes.ErrInvalidToken, as VerifySignature reports one.

<sub>[inspect/inspect.go](../../inspect/inspect.go)</sub>
<a id="inspect.VerifySignature"></a>

### inspect.VerifySignature

```go
func VerifySignature(token string, pub ed25519.PublicKey) error
```

VerifySignature checks the Ed25519 signature on a compact token against pub, and nothing else. A forged or altered token, or one longer than MaxTokenBytes, is limes.ErrInvalidToken; a pub that is no Ed25519 public key is ErrInvalidKey.
